datasets.name: CNSIM
datasets.description: General-purpose simulated cardiovascular/health dataset. Continuous lab values (LAB_TSC, LAB_TRIG, LAB_HDL, LAB_GLUC_ADJUSTED), a BMI measure (PM_BMI_CONTINUOUS), and binary disease indicators (DIS_CVA, DIS_DIAB, MEDI_LPD).
datasets.fits_when: No more specific dataset below fits better — the sensible default for most numeric/tabular operations.

datasets.name: DASIM
datasets.description: Similar shape to CNSIM (health-style numeric/binary columns: LAB_TSC, LAB_TRIG, LAB_HDL, LAB_GLUC_FASTING, PM_BMI_CONTINUOUS, DIS_CVA, DIS_DIAB, DIS_AMI) but larger, 10000 rows per study.
datasets.fits_when: The function's behavior specifically depends on a larger sample size (e.g. aggregation stability, performance-sensitive logic).

datasets.name: DATASET
datasets.description: Small dataset purpose-built for type/edge-case coverage: columns include CHARACTER, LOGICAL, NA_VALUES, NULL_VALUES, INTEGER, NON_NEGATIVE_INTEGER, POSITIVE_INTEGER, and more.
datasets.fits_when: The function's behavior depends on specific R data types, missing values (NA/NULL), or value-range edge cases (e.g. type coercion, validation, non-negative/positive constraints).

datasets.name: DISCORDANT
datasets.description: Tiny 2-column dataset (A, B) for concordance/discordance-style paired comparisons.
datasets.fits_when: The function specifically computes agreement/concordance/discordance between two paired variables.

datasets.name: SURVIVAL
datasets.description: Survival-analysis-style dataset with time-to-event columns (time.id, starttime, endtime, survtime, cens) plus covariates like age.60.
datasets.fits_when: The function performs or supports survival/time-to-event analysis.
